name: Target phrases the filter did not read — Havoc Eater, Norritt, Mirror of the Forebears, Admiral Beckett Brass, Secret Tunnel, Jabari's Influence
notes: Found from the audit's "phrases not understood" list (2026-11-20). Havoc Eater's "for each opponent, goad up to one target creature that opponent controls" offered every permanent (lands, planeswalkers, the card): the words are rewritten as "… an opponent controls", as "they control" already was. Norritt / Nettling Imp's "non-Wall creature the active player has controlled continuously since the beginning of the turn" offered every permanent: the player words are dropped (any player's, as for Kitt Kanto's "that player"), also in the pronoun's antecedent. Mirror of the Forebears' fired copy ignored the chosen creature type: _addAbilityPseudo writes the source's chosen type into the fired text. Admiral Beckett Brass's "controlled by a player who was dealt combat damage by three or more Pirates" offered nothing: any player's. Secret Tunnel's "creatures you control that share a creature type" offered nothing: a creature that shares a type with another the words allow. Jabari's Influence's "creature that attacked you this turn" offered nothing: a creature marked attacking you ("that attacked / blocked this turn": attacking / blocking).
